notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
For these upcoming holidays, we want to wish you all a time full of joy and peace. 

Much love, happiness, time spent in a family atmosphere with the smell of gingerbread and hot chocolate in the air. Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: MythBusters: The Game Kickstarter is on!
notes.notes:
[h3][h2]Well well well![/h2]

See what game just got its Kickstarter launch! It’s MythBusters: The Game, which is as awesome as it sounds. 

[previewyoutube=X_zMiKBilJc;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s being developed by Byte Barrel, the biggest nerds we’ve met (there’s always someone wearing a NASA t-shirt, I think it’s their dress code). They let us play it, and it’s sweet! 

Give it a shot. You can even get the demo! We totally recommend it.

[url=https://mov.gs/mbks]See MythBusters: The Game Kickstarter[/url]

Also, if you don’t want to miss any news, add it to your wishlist:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/811550/MythBusters_The_Game__Crazy_Experiments_Simulator/

notes.title: #4 Car Wash Simulator DevLog
notes.notes:
Hello!

We’re back with another report from the progress on Car Wash Simulator! This time we’ve worked on the game menu. Is it better to add a static or rendered graphic? It was quite a dilemma for us, but finally, we’ve chosen the second solution. Today we’ll show you some screens from our work on background graphics for Car Wash Simulator main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/7e66a1250e28968dce8c75ffa5b3220b5babade4.jpg[/img]

Elements of the illustration in the 3D graphics program

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/897a5b53b358d00d04b83782bb277dcdb8a33fe5.jpg[/img]

Final models used in rendering

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/46a5258b3b8be0af58c5859d339c07ee949cd119.jpg[/img]

Graphic with the added shadow layer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/8accb79b16fc29998a16c2d87538371f019e8ca2.jpg[/img]

Final render with beauty layer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/444bfe0316022e82af0700e325504a6a57794152.jpg[/img]

And here’s a final graphic after a treatment in Photoshop with composition effects, stylistics, and the color mastering

We hope you like it :)

That’s all for this week’s devlog. Have a great weekend, and keep an eye on the next updates!

notes.title: #2 Car Wash Simulator DevLog
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's time to present to you the new pictures from the Car Wash Simulator. We're still working on graphics and also on its improves. We're putting new elements, like these beautiful palm trees that grew up this week. They're majestically moving on the wind. You can see them on one of the screens:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/bfa5fa44d4591ac3adf2aece2f3471ae2598fda5.jpg[/img]

In the next picture, you can see a car wash entrance. It'll be your kingdom, and it's also the place where you'll have to make decisions related to your business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/2907ee296cbe8c98e8481737bd798530127eec34.jpg[/img]

This screen presents an office during the workday. Here you'll able to make shopping, take client's orders, and contact them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/d9e856299f4af3adcc2c73c3bb8d8e168b94d75f.jpg[/img]

Have a great day, and keep an eye on our updates!

notes.title: #1 Car Wash Simulator DevLog
notes.notes:
Greetings from the sunny West Coast, the place where your car wash will locate! In the middle of a dangerous neighborhood, you have to take care of your business. Will your customers be only honest citizens?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/08edcc431efe8fdb11cfa58d55c4845eb0f2d22c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/f8019c8118d1696421ea42fcfd7e4d62ad1b0554.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the works on Car Wash Simulator are going intensively. Today, we’ll show you some pictures of the production. From this week, we also start to regularly inform about the production progress of the Car Wash Simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/92461e574a5647f30819ad1b007bc9a71dcf12c5.jpg[/img]

These are two models of ozonizers that will be available for your car wash. Both models, of course, differ in power and efficiency. The statistics influence the speed of executing the orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34059616/e7310b0ed3e45822eb5e42c7ef41c8460f751186.jpg[/img]

Along with the development of your car wash, you’ll able to start to offer additional services, which, of course, will enable you to gain extra profits. In this case, you can up car mats for sale. 

Keep an eye on our updates, more information coming soon!
